text.summary: The application is a web service that provides API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting text summaries. It uses a SQL database to store summaries and can be accessed through six HTTP endpoints. The service also includes a summarizer module that generates text summaries from URLs.
text.how_it_works: When the application is started, the app/db.py::init_db function sets up the database. The app/main.py::create_application function creates a FastAPI application with routers for ping and summaries. The app/api/ping.py::pong endpoint returns environment and testing settings. The app/api/summaries.py module handles CRUD operations on summaries, interacting with the database through the app.api.crud module. The app/summarizer.py module generates text summaries from URLs, which are then saved to the database. Requests to the API endpoints are handled by the corresponding functions in app/api/summaries.py, such as app/api/summaries.py::read_all_summaries, app/api/summaries.py::create_summary, and app/api/summaries.py::update_summary.
